correctness.rationale: For every n>=2 and p in (0,1), independent edge-absence products yield exact source and sink probabilities, triangular site cross-covariance and the finite total covariance. Under p=c/n, target-column exposure produces explicit martingale increments; their conditional quadratic variations concentrate in L2 by independent outgoing-row factors, while uniformly bounded fourth moments imply Lindeberg. The limiting covariance entries are A(c) and B(c); strict decay of rho follows by differentiating and using tanh(x)<x. The packaged verifier passed 1319 exact assertions and controlled numerical checks, including independent enumeration of all DAG edge subsets through order six and direct checks of martingale increment formulas. The general proof does not rely on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Counts of indegree-zero and outdegree-zero vertices are natural entry/exit bottleneck statistics in ordered random networks. The exact site-dependence law and joint CLT quantify their simultaneous uncertainty, which is not recovered from two marginal laws. The explicit correlation has a strict density response from nearly perfect coupling to asymptotic decorrelation; its proof requires a nontrivial martingale CLT and precise cross-moment calculation rather than a renamed elementary identity.
